title: What do I do if my child shows regression in skills?
metaTitle: Handling Skill Regression in Autism Therapy - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand how Pinnacle Blooms Network addresses and handles regression in therapy progress, ensuring your child's continued development and growth.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, your concerns are our top priority. If you notice a regression in your child's skills, it's essential to communicate this with us. We understand that progress isn't always linear, and we are prepared to reflect, reassess, and adjust our therapeutic approach to maintain the path toward the set goals. Rest assured, our team is always on your side, striving to ensure your child achieves their full potential.
